svg.text: Fig. 1. SurgicalVLA: SmolVLA with past-only object tokens, explicit-to-latent reasoning and a phase- and object-conditioned MoE action expert

g.title: instruction ℓ · LIBERO-Spatial episode 1261. The target phrase “black bowl” is read from the instruction by a rule, with a grounded SmolVLM2 answer as fallback; it prompts SAM 3.
g.text: “pick up the black bowl next to the
cookie box and place it on the plate”

g.title: o_t third-person
o_t wrist
proprio s_t ∈ ℝ8 (padded to 32) · [8] → [32]
tokenizer + embedding · [≤ 48] → [≤ 48, 960] · The instruction's token embeddings, frozen.
SigLIP vision encoder · [2, 3, 512, 512] → [128, 960] · SmolVLM2's vision tower; 32×32 patches pooled 4× by pixel shuffle to 64 tokens per camera.
state projection · [32] → [1, 960]

g.text: frame t only · cached for training, computed live at inference (236 ms / chunk)

g.title: 3 × “black bowl” + end effector
frozen perception (outside the policy) · Without memory: frame t only, so inputs never see the future.
g.text: SAM 3: masks for the target phrase

g.title: K = 4 · [4, 384 + 8]: pose = box(4), centroid(2), depth, score · One descriptor per object; RoboTwin adds a second end effector (K = 5).
object projector · [4, 392] → [4, 960] (+ context c_obj ∈ ℝ^{720}) · Fuses feature and pose into one prefix token per object, and a pooled object context c_obj for the MoE router.
cobj · Object context, given to every MoE router.
explicit CoT text · Teacher-forced; the probability of feeding it decays 1 → 0 over the first 25 k steps, so inference is latent-only.
latent queries · [4, 960]
prefix tokens · ≈ 233 × 960 · images | text | objects | state attend bidirectionally; CoT and latent queries are causal (they see everything before them).
SmolVLM2 decoder · first 16 of 32 layers · d = 960 · [≈ 233, 960] → K, V per layer · Its keys and values are cached for all 10 denoising steps.
g.text: SmolVLM2 decoder · first 16 of 32 layers · d = 960
self-attention + SwiGLU · 204.6 M · frozen · run once per action chunk
② Flow-matching action expert (trained) · phase- and object-conditioned MoE

g.title: noisy · [50, 32] + τ · Noisy action chunk at flow time τ.
g.text: x_τ = τ ε + (1 − τ) a, τ ~ Beta(1.5, 1)

g.title: action + time MLP
action expert · [50, 720] → [50, 720] · SmolVLA's expert with every FFN up-cycled to a mixture of experts.
action out
v_θ · [50, 32] (7 used on LIBERO)
10 Euler steps · Integrates noise → at:t+50; RL rollouts use the SDE with the ReinFlow noise head (2.1 M).
zin
attention · 1.84 M
g.text: ℓ odd: cross-attn to prefix K, V

g.title: router (fp32) · Routes each action token by its content, the predicted manipulation phase and the object context. Switch load-balancing loss keeps experts in use.
e_phase · Phase embedding ∈ ℝ^720: from the CoT phase token when the trace is fed, else projected from the pooled prefix.
c_obj
expert 1 ✓ · Routed expert, initialised from SmolVLA's FFN (up-cycling). Selected for this token (top-2).
expert 2 · Routed expert, initialised from SmolVLA's FFN (up-cycling).
expert 3 ✓ · Routed expert, initialised from SmolVLA's FFN (up-cycling). Selected for this token (top-2).
expert 4 · Routed expert, initialised from SmolVLA's FFN (up-cycling).
shared expert
Σ · Shared output + gate-weighted sum of the 2 selected experts.
zout

g.text: FFN per layer: 22.1 M (4 routed + 1 shared);
active: shared + 2 of 4 = 3× SmolVLA FFN compute

g.title: aux vision heads · 0.83 M · [720] → MLP 512 → heads · Reads the action expert, so the targets shape features the policy acts on while the VLM stays frozen.
phase head · 720 → 4 (→ e_phase) · Input: the CoT phase token's output when the trace is fed, else the projected pooled prefix.
latent predictor · 1.85 M · [4, 960] → [960]
g.text: in: mean of the 4 latent-query outputs

ℒFM = ‖vθ − (ε − a)‖² · 1
ℒaux · 0.1 / 0.1 / 0.1 / 0.02 · Confidence-weighted regression to the cached targets.
ℒCoT · 0.1 (cross-entropy)
ℒphase · 0.1
ℒlatent = 1 − cos(·, sg[·]) · 0.1
mask · tracks · gripper
feature cache (offline) · keyed by (episode, frame); targets every 4th frame · Targets may use the whole episode; they only enter losses. Never simulator ground truth, which is kept for validation.

g.title: target encoder (stop-gradient) · o_{t+10}, all cameras → mean token [960] · Target: the mean image-token embedding of the frame 10 steps (1 s at 10 fps) ahead. With the vision encoder frozen this is the encoder itself; an EMA copy (decay 0.99) is kept only when the vision encoder trains.
ot+10

g.text: ℒ = ℒFM + Σk wk ℒaux,k + 0.1 ℒlatent
Only ℒFM reaches the action output directly;
the auxiliary losses train the action expert,
the object projector and the latent queries.
At inference: object tokens + latent queries only;
no text decoding, no auxiliary heads.
Cost per chunk: 242 ms policy + 236 ms perception.

svg.text: Example: LIBERO-Spatial episode 1261, frame t = 36, target phrase “black bowl”. 792 M parameters, 442 M trained (upcycled MoE); the VLM and all perception models stay frozen.
